The '''Kinun Depot system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Pelgrin sector/Legends|Pelgrin sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the location known as [[Kinun Depot]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

At some point by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' states that [[Myo/Legends|Myo]] was present at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] first met [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], an event dated to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, it can be deduced that Myo traveled from [[Kinun Depot]] to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at some point by that date.</ref> the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] [[Malak (Rodian)|Malak]] stopped at Kinun Depot to [[Fuel/Legends|refuel]]. While there, [[Myo/Legends|Myo]], an [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] previously [[Slavery/Legends|captured]] by Malak, escaped the Rodian's [[Malak's starship|starship]]<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> and booked passage to<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|348|Myo}}</ref> the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kinun Depot system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square R-18.<ref name="TEA" />
